theme: Dark Mode Only - Pro Editing Studio (DaVinci Resolve / Premiere Pro aesthetic)

typography.rules: Never use Inter for headings. Hierarchy ceiling is text-3xl for this desktop dashboard to preserve data density. Use monospace extensively for metrics, timestamps, and log outputs.

colors.rules: Strict adherence to Tinted Grey rule. Avoid pure #000000. Accent colors should be highly vibrant to pop against dark panels (Tactical Minimalism). Do not use broad gradients. No teal green.

spacing_and_layout.strategy: Mode B: High Density Grid (Dashboards / Analytics)
spacing_and_layout.containers: All containers must have internal padding of p-4 to p-6. Panels must use surface_base or surface_elevated with 1px borders.
spacing_and_layout.structure: IDE Layout Strategy: Left Sidebar for Metadata/Settings, Top Center for Video Player & Transport Controls, Bottom Center for Timeline/Transcript, Right Sidebar for Clip Results & Scoring Breakdown.
spacing_and_layout.borders: Pro editing tools demand sharp edges: rounded-none or rounded-sm (max 4px). Avoid playful bubble radius.

visual_enhancers.surface: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Exposed skeletons. Data dense tables.
visual_enhancers.active_states: Replace soft shadows with 1px solid stroke (accent_primary) + 2px inner glow for active elements.
visual_enhancers.overlays: CRITICAL: No transparent backgrounds for dropdowns/modals. Use solid surface_elevated with a distinct border.
visual_enhancers.score_meters: For the 8 sub-metrics (Hook, Payoff, etc.): Use tiny horizontal progress bars (h-1.5) paired with monospace numbers. Green/Amber/Red based on 0-100 scale.

component_guidelines.dropzone: Minimalist bordered rectangle (border-dashed, border-neutral-600). Change to solid accent_primary on drag. Clear monospace upload progress.
component_guidelines.processing_timeline: Vertical terminal-like log or stepper. Monospace text. Blinking cursor for active step. Colors: Amber (Processing), Green (Done).
component_guidelines.transcript_viewer: List format. Colored pills for Speaker 1, Speaker 2. Clickable timestamps (JetBrains Mono). Hover states highlight the paragraph.
component_guidelines.candidate_cards: Extremely data-dense. Flex rows. Title, Timecode (Start-End), Score. Expandable to show the 8 sub-metric bars and 'Why selected'. Icon-only action buttons (Play, Generate, Delete).
component_guidelines.buttons: Sharp edges, flat colors. Primary button is accent_primary. Secondary buttons are surface_elevated with hover:bg-white/10.
component_guidelines.forms: Use Shadcn Form components. Dark inputs with 1px border. No native inputs.

motion.rules: Minimalist. Zero parallax. Zero floaty animations. Tool is for efficiency.
motion.specifics: Instant visual feedback on hover (150ms color transition). Progress bars should animate width smoothly.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA contrast. Text must be legible on dark panels.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements, buttons, form inputs, menus, and scores MUST include a `data-testid` attribute using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., `data-testid='generate-clip-button'`).

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a PRO VIDEO EDITING TOOL, not a SaaS landing page. It must feel like DaVinci Resolve or Adobe Premiere.
Strictly enforce Dark Mode. Do not build light mode toggles.
Do NOT use HTML-based components for advanced interactions. Rely completely on Shadcn UI (Dropdowns, Tabs, Sliders) styled for the dark theme.

Implement the 8 sub-metrics (Hook, Standalone clarity, Payoff, Info/entertainment value, Emotional interest, Curiosity, Context completeness, Social-media appeal) using Shadcn Progress or custom dense CSS bars.
Ensure `data-testid` attributes are present on EVERY interactive element for testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Build a distinctive, highly functional frontend. Avoid generic center-aligned single column layouts; use full-width dense grid/panel structures. DO NOT use `transition: all`. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and subtle 1px borders, avoiding massive shadows. Use sonner for toast notifications. Use lucide-react for icons. Missing categories will not fallback to placeholder images; text-only or custom SVGs must be used.
